A1.justification: Both PDFs describe AbstRaL and GranulAR, with readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A-G. Relocated content and renumbered tables can be matched reliably.

before.justification: Sections 5.1-5.2 and Appendix D report original GSM robustness experiments, ablations, and OOD evaluations of trained LLMs.

after.justification: Retains the original experimental results and adds weaker-oracle findings in Section 5.3 and an error analysis in Appendix E.

M1.justification: The four-step AbstRaL pipeline, GranulAR format, SFT objective, and GRPO abstraction rewards remain unchanged. Testing another rewriting oracle varies an experimental configuration without introducing a new method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use GSM8K-derived training data, the same GSM-Symbolic and GSM-Plus perturbations, and the same mathematical and general OOD tasks. The relocated OOD tables and additional analyses introduce no new dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains CoT-8S, PoT-8S, CoT-RL, CoA, AoT, and SyReLM. OOD comparisons retain Ori-SFT, CoT-RL, and CoA, and the matched appendix comparisons also retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: Section 5.3 adds a control using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct instead of Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct to rewrite training traces. Appendix E adds manual inspection restricted to 35 GSM8K questions where Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct succeeds with CoT-8S but fails with AbstRaL. Existing benchmark protocols are retained.

E4.justification: Beyond the retained ablations and successful reasoning examples, v4 adds an oracle-strength check and a targeted 35-case error analysis, illustrated by the new Table 9. These are limited additions to the existing diagnostic evidence.

E5.justification: Both retain 50 GSM-Symbolic evaluation rounds with means and standard deviations, and Appendix D's bootstrap significance tests at p < 0.05. The additions introduce no new uncertainty reporting or repeated-run information.

E6.justification: All matched benchmark and ablation table values are unchanged. Newly reported findings include roughly equal performance with the weaker oracle and misunderstandings in all 35 inspected failures. New Table 9 shows AbstRaL answering 21 instead of the correct 18; the weaker-oracle finding has no numerical breakdown.

T1.justification: The symbolic reward definition, GRPO equations (2)-(4), and Appendix F's theoretical open problems are unchanged. The expanded discussion adds conceptual explanations, without new formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about robustness and OOD generalization. Section 5.2's wording about outperforming baselines across all tested OOD datasets already appeared in v3's Appendix D.

C2.justification: Section 5.3 expands the argument that improvements arise from AbstRaL's learning scheme rather than superior reasoning knowledge distilled from the oracle. Appendix E newly identifies overthinking and problem misunderstanding as failure mechanisms. The existing limitations in Appendix G remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 5.3 newly specifies Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the rewriting oracle for the additional training-data check. Appendix B's existing hyperparameters, hardware, timings, filtering counts, and access information remain unchanged; detailed settings for the additional check are not supplied.

R1.justification: The reference list and related-work section are unchanged after accounting for pagination. Positioning relative to data augmentation, abstract reasoning methods, planning, and reinforcement learning is retained.

P1.justification: V4 expands Section 5.3, adds an Error Analysis paragraph, and revises the OOD-results narration. It also corrects grammar and updates publication headers, affiliations, and acknowledgements. The overall section structure and most prose remain intact.

P2.justification: V3's full appendix OOD Tables 6-7 become v4's main-text Tables 3-4, replacing the earlier partial summary. V4 adds the failure-example Table 9, reflows other tables, and corrects malformed delimiter glyphs in appendix examples and prompts. Figures 1-5 are retained.

improvement.justification: The new error audit and failure example expose a concrete weakness absent from v3's successful case studies. Moving complete OOD tables into the main text and correcting prompt notation improve accessibility. The oracle check adds useful support, but its missing numerical breakdown and detailed settings limit the evidential gain.
